gen-gf-comic-relief-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans has a technical, approachable manner, with bowls that stay generously open inside. And Comic Relief sits above it as a bold display heading, its strokes uniform and its rounded shapes left unfinished on one side.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-allerta: Tubing bent into letters, that's Funnel Display, with strokes that never vary in width. And Allerta follows in a neutral, businesslike sans-serif, spaced loosely with a prominent x-height that keeps a long page easy to move through.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Commanding and expressive, Funnel Display is drawn with strokes of constant width. It excels at making a loud first impression, while Alumni Sans SC stays contemporary and squeezed, with oversized lowercase, ideal for packing in text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arsenal-sc: Funnel Display looks like spaghetti: strokes of one width, curves that stop short of closing. Arsenal SC takes over where it leaves off, with a faint thick-thin shift and tight fit that suit steady reading far better than a headline voice would.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-epunda-sans: Funnel Display draws like bent wire, with no visible difference between up and side strokes. And Epunda Sans carries the reading, its oversized e and a counters letting daylight into every curve, so a long page stays comfortable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hammersmith-one: Hammersmith One reads clean and neutral, a sans-serif whose capitals stand barely above lowercase and whose strokes are rounded like cut cord. Funnel Display supplies the commanding, wire-like voice on top.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-krona-one: Approachable and loosely spaced, Krona One is a sans-serif whose lowercase carries the stature of cast iron capitals. And Funnel Display above it traces every letter as if with one marker, so a longer passage feels sturdy and unhurried.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-matemasie: Funnel Display is built from open, spaghetti-like strokes that never change width, and its c tips stay well apart. Matemasie closes things in underneath, tidy and clean.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall like rolled cord, clean and neutral in tone. Funnel Display, by contrast, bends thin steel rod into every letter, and Menbere then lets a longer passage run along quietly beneath it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mitr: Funnel Display looks like bent rope or tubing, every stroke the same width and every c tip held apart. But it earns its keep when big and short, while Mitr, a contemporary sans-serif, closes the gap between x-height and cap height.
